root: ^Well ya know, I was a little unsure about your negotiation but looks like what people were saying wasn't right at all!
^I'm gonna take that as a compliment.
^Say! Why on earth are you moving around so much anyways? It's pretty stupid to change location every night or two.
^Well I lost something very special when I moved here a couple months back, somehow it made it's way to the top of the island, so I gotta go to the top to get it back.
^Wow! Well whatever you lost it must be real valuabl-
^Well Good luck, ya know a couple weeks ago I lost something valuable, in my old house I left a momento from my mom, couldn't find my house.
^Tell you what it's amazing what you realize you can do when whats at stake is important. I didnt sleep for days searching.
^Well here's hoping I get some sleep haha.
